# Nibras Code

> Nibras Code (https://nibrascode.com) is a real, independent project by Mahir Aliyev (Mahir Əliyev) from Azerbaijan. It offers free browser tools (PDF, image, QR, ZIP), Android apps, an AI assistant (Nibras AI), guides and a programming/Arabic learning library. The site is in Azerbaijani, English, Turkish, Arabic and Russian.

## Facts
- Type: independent personal project, not a company with an office. No phone, no physical address.
- Founder: Mahir Aliyev. About page: https://nibrascode.com/about
- Official contact (only): nibrascode@gmail.com
- Official channel: https://www.youtube.com/@NibrasCode
- Price: tools and Nibras AI are free. No account is required for the tools.
- Reviews: the site shows no invented stars, ratings, testimonials or download counts.

## Privacy model
- PDF, image, QR, vCard, Wi-Fi QR and ZIP tools run in the user's browser. Files are not uploaded to a server.
- Nibras AI: text the user sends goes to a server to produce an answer.
- Each Android app has its own privacy policy: https://nibrascode.com/privacy

## Main sections
- PDF tools (merge, split, compress, unlock, crop, page numbers, OCR, Word/Excel to PDF, redact, invoice, and more): https://nibrascode.com/pdf
- Image tools (compress, resize, convert, crop/rotate, background removal): https://nibrascode.com/image , https://nibrascode.com/erase
- QR codes (URL, Wi-Fi, contact card): https://nibrascode.com/qr
- ZIP: https://nibrascode.com/zip
- Nibras AI assistant: https://nibrascode.com/ai
- Android apps: https://nibrascode.com/apps
- How-to guides: https://nibrascode.com/nece
- Transparency and service level: https://nibrascode.com/trust
- Terms: https://nibrascode.com/terms
- Contact: https://nibrascode.com/contact

## Apps (official store links)
- Nibras PDF: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nibras.pdf
- Nibras QR: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nibras.qr
- Nibras Arabic: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nibrasarabic.app
- Huawei AppGallery: https://urldra.cloud.huawei.com/CkyddvOyXK

## Service level (honest)
- Free tools are kept working on a best-effort basis. There is no uptime guarantee or paid SLA.
- Nibras AI can be slow or briefly unavailable; answers can be wrong.
- Problems: email nibrascode@gmail.com with the page and what happened.

## Other languages
- English: https://nibrascode.com/en · Turkish: https://nibrascode.com/tr · Arabic: https://nibrascode.com/ar · Russian: https://nibrascode.com/ru
